name: col-game
description: Col (Conway's map-colouring game) and Myopic Col (its directed cousin on linked lists and binary trees) in the browser with an exact combinatorial-game-theory engine: canonical values, every move marked winning or losing, the path lemma of Bovee–Burke–Tennenhouse (2016) checked and their binary-tree conjecture tested on 31 million positions. TypeScript, no runtime deps.
